documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Un-Audited Financial Results For Quarter Ended 30Th June 2026

analysis.summary: Menon Bearings reported its highest-ever quarterly sales, EBITDA, profit before tax, and PAT for Q1 FY27, driven by healthy demand, improved operational efficiencies, and cost optimization. Management highlighted strong performance across standalone and consolidated segments, with significant growth in revenue and profitability. The company remains optimistic about its outlook, supported by potential new business from recent visits to Canada and the USA, expanding export geographies, and increased capacities without major land investments for the next two years. Furthermore, management noted progress in the brakes and aluminium segments, alongside strategic efforts to maintain robust margins despite supply chain and input cost pressures. Menon Bearings reported its highest ever quarterly revenue from operations at Rs.

guidance.claim: The company expects the total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores.
guidance.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

guidance.claim: For the Alkop business, the management is targeting INR100 crores for this year and around INR125 crores for next year.
guidance.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

guidance.claim: Management projects a conservative year-on-year growth target of 20% plus.
guidance.quote: You see, there is always a target, we have set ourselves on a conservative basis of 20% plus year on year.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting an overall turnover growth rate of 25% year-on-year for the next few years.
guidance.quote: And again, we will be sustaining this because of increase in the overall turnover which we are targeting at a rate of 25% year-on-year for next few years.

guidance.claim: Management targets reaching INR 500 crores by the year 2028.
guidance.quote: And we will take all-out efforts to see how we can reach INR500 crores by '28.

guidance.claim: EBITDA margins are projected to be maintained between 20% and 22% during the next two years.
guidance.quote: I again assure you that considering the present situation going forward, we will be able to maintain EBITDA more than 20% and it should be about between 20% to 22% during next two years.

guidance.claim: Management estimates FY27 revenues to exceed INR 360 crores.
guidance.quote: Precisely, what we have estimated is more than INR 360 crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: While the global business environment continues to present certain uncertainties, the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that visits to Canada and the USA are expected to yield substantial volumes in the coming period.
demand_outlook.quote: That is because, more particularly, due to our last month's visit to Canada and USA, is expected to yield substantial volumes in the coming period of the year.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to operate within its primary auto components segment, where sustained demand is being observed.
demand_outlook.quote: We continue to operate within our primary segment of auto components where we are seeing sustained demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports to the USA market have increased by almost 50% over the previous year.
demand_outlook.quote: So far as USA market is concerned, our exports have gone up by almost 50% over last year so far as USA market is concerned and there is a lot of opportunities we are looking for.

demand_outlook.claim: European countries are looking to divert volumes and businesses from China to India and are approaching the company for vendor opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Since European countries are looking to divert their volumes and businesses from China to India and they are tapping our doors and we'll be very happy to see that they come into our fold from the next year.

capex_expansion.claim: The company planned a CapEx of around INR4 crores for Alkop alone for the year.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

capex_expansion.claim: Planned capital expenditure is INR 7 crores for Alkop and INR 3 crores for brakes.
capex_expansion.quote: And for Alkop, it is INR7 crores and brakes, it is INR3 crores.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins in the brakes segment reached 25% during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: But at the same time, I would like to tell you that right from 12% EBITDA earlier, now we have reached to 25% EBITDA in brakes also.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated margins are expected to sustain around 20% to 21% over a period of time.
margins_costs.quote: But overall, on a consolidated basis, if you see, we will sustainaround 20% to 21% of margins over a period of time.

margins_costs.claim: Carbide tool prices for automobile manufacturers have increased by 300%.
margins_costs.quote: Consumables, for example, carbide tools for all manufacturers, all automobile carbide tools are required.Those carbide tools price are increased by 300%.

margins_costs.claim: The company successfully passed on the burden of raw material price increases to customers to a large extent.
margins_costs.quote: raw material prices are going up, we were successful in passing on that burden of raw material to the customers to the larger extent.

margins_costs.claim: The government is offering a 2.75% subvention on export subsidy following company requests.
margins_costs.quote: Honourable Prime Minister has considered that, our Ministry of Commerce has considered, and they are now offering 2.75% subvention on export subsidy.

orders_capacity.claim: Standalone bi-metal sales increased by 40.41% year-on-year to INR67.06 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: during the quarter sales increased to INR67.06 crores from INR47.76 crores as compared to the corresponding quarter of the last year that is year-on-year increase of 40.41% and further increased by about 41%.

orders_capacity.claim: Consolidated sales increased to INR91.79 crores registering a growth of 36.57%.
orders_capacity.quote: on a consolidated basis, the sales increased to INR91.79 crores as compared to INR67.21 crores last year, same quarter, registering a growth of 36.57%.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization is currently around 80% for the bearing segment.
orders_capacity.quote: Roughly, I will tell you bearing around 80%.

orders_capacity.claim: The new development parts pipeline includes 51 new parts across major customers representing a business value of almost INR 30 crores within this year and next year.
orders_capacity.quote: Our new development parts pipeline is robust with 51 new parts across major customers like John Deere for India domestic and exports as well. Eaton, Taco Prestolite and Mayekawa representing a business value of almost INR 30 crores within this year and next year.

orders_capacity.claim: The Bi-Metal division has a robust pipeline of more than INR 50 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: With this, apart from this, in Bi-Metal division also, we are having a robust pipeline of more than INR 50 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The pipeline for brakes is almost INR 10 crores for the next two years.
orders_capacity.quote: And that for the breaks, it is almost INR 10 crores for the next two years.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization for Menon Alkop is operating at 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: Utilization as of now is 65% and it is likely to go up to 90% by the end of this year so that we will have to engage another furnace next year.

capital_allocation.claim: CapEx for bi-metal and Alkop will be funded through internal accruals only without taking any fresh loan.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board has declared a dividend of Rs. 2 per share having a face value of Re. 1 each.
capital_allocation.quote: Note: The Board has declared Dividend of Rs. 2 per share having face value of Re. 1 each

risks_headwinds.claim: Merchant export orders were stuck for the last three months due to backlogs caused by the Strait of Hormuz and war.
risks_headwinds.quote: But last three months, those merchant export orders were stuck because of backlog because of the Straight of Hormuz and the war.

risks_headwinds.claim: The total turnaround time of debtors for exports, particularly in the USA, is more than 180 days.
risks_headwinds.quote: particularly in USA, the total turnaround time of debtors is more than 180 days.

risks_headwinds.claim: Export shipments to African countries via Dubai were temporarily halted for three months, resulting in an estimated loss of INR 2 crores of business.
risks_headwinds.quote: For last three months, we have -- that export is halted. That has affected to the extent of almost INR2 crores of business that we have lost during last three months.

management_commitments.claim: The dynamometer for the brake segment is expected to be under construction and ready by the end of August.
management_commitments.quote: You see, basically that is under construction now and is expected by the end of August.

management_commitments.claim: The technical team expects the dynamometer testing rig to be fully running by September end.
management_commitments.quote: So by September end, it should be all running.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects a business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores in the first year for railway brakes, eventually going up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within next two years.
management_commitments.quote: we expect that to start with, we will have a business of around INR5 crores to INR6 crores to start with and eventually it will go up to INR25 crores to INR30 crores within next two years.

management_commitments.claim: Engine bearing division is expected to already start supplying by quarter three or quarter four.
management_commitments.quote: So you will see by the quarter three, quarter four, where engine bearing will already be started supplying.

management_commitments.claim: Aluminium division samples should be submitted and orders should start coming by next year, 2027.
management_commitments.quote: And maybe by next year, Alkop also should be able -- samples should be submitted by next year, by 2027.Orders for aluminium division also should start coming to surface.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets reaching an INR 500 crore turnover by 2028.
management_commitments.quote: And we will take all-out efforts to see how we can reach INR500 crores by '28.

management_commitments.claim: Management commits to maintaining EBITDA margins between 20% and 22% over the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: I again assure you that considering the present situation going forward, we will be able to maintain EBITDA more than 20% and it should be about between 20% to 22% during next two years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
